name: Disable Smbv1 & SMB Signing
description: Disables the outdated and insecure SMBv1 protocol
commands:
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters" /v SMB1 /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
 
 reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\mrxsmb10" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f
 
 reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanWorkstation" /v DependOnService /t REG_MULTI_SZ /d "Bowser\0MRxSmb20\0NSI\0" /f
 
 sc stop lanmanserver
 
 sc start lanmanserver
 
 sc stop lanmanworkstation
 
 sc start lanmanworkstation
